name: reading-test-triage
prompt: Run the test suite for this project (pytest, or `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests` if pytest isn't available) and you'll find 2 of the ~120 generated tests in `tests/test_generated.py` fail. All the failures trace back to a single real bug in one function in `calc_pkg/mathutils.py`. Find and fix that bug so every test passes. Do not modify anything under `tests/`.
